The '''Spice rack''' is used as an upgrade for the [[Cauldron]]. It will typically be the first upgrade for the cauldron due to its low cost.

== Usage ==
=== Level 2 Cauldron items include: ===
* {{Item link|Black Soup}}
* {{Item link|Muckshake}} - introduced in [[Version history#0.202.14 .28HEARTH .26 HOME.29|Hearth and Home]].
* {{Item link|Onion Soup}}
* {{Item link|Sausages}}
* {{Item link|Serpent Stew}}
* {{Item link|Turnip Stew}}

* For other upgrades, see [[Cauldron]].

Must be placed hanging from the ceiling or a shelf. Can be done using a [[Wood Beam 2 m|wood beam]].

== Notes ==
* The Spice rack was introduced in [[Version history#0.202.14 .28HEARTH .26 HOME.29|Hearth and Home]] on September 16th, 2021.

'''Rotten meat''' is a type of consumable.

Consuming rotten meat gives the [[Feeling sick]] effect, the same as [[Bukeperries]]. It is useful to switch to different [[Food]]s.

== Availability ==
* Drops from mounds of flesh in [[Putrid Hole]]s.
* Drops from [[Vile]]

{{infobox character | name = The Bog Witch | image = The Bog Witch.png | caption = | id = BogWitch | aliases = | affiliation = | marital = | birthDate = | birthPlace = | deathDate = | deathPlace = | species = Greydwarf | gender = Female | height = | weight = | eyes = Light blue |Release Ver.=}} '''The Bog Witch''' is a [[Creatures#NPCs|Greydwarf trader]] found in the [[Swamp]] biome. She sells unique ingredients and items from her swamp hut which can be purchased with [[Coins]], with additional items unlocking as the world progresses. Her spices and serving tray are required to prepare and eat a [[Feast]]. ==Location== During world generation, up to 10 spawn locations are determined for The Bog Witch. All spawn locations are within [[Swamp]] biomes, each at least 1000 meters apart, and only found between 3000 and 8000 meters from the world center. Approaching any of these locations will permanently place The Bog Witch there, nullifying all other potential spawns. When discovered, a cauldron icon will appear on the world map. She spawns with her own [[Points of Interest (POI)|point of interest]], a small hut decorated with various potions. A [[Greydwarf]] sits next to the entrance, and a [[Kvastur]] constantly sweeps inside the hut interior. The hut has [[Comfort]] level three and grants the player all relevant buffs. The camp is surrounded by a shimmering, transparent dome that acts as a safety zone that [[Creatures]] cannot enter.
